screen.title: Pair a Host
troubleshoot_label: If pairing fails on the host
troubleshoot_text: If the host is already paired with a different account, run:
scan_qr.web_fallback: QR scanning isn't supported on web. Please use the pairing code flow instead.
scan_qr.camera_permission_description: PocketShell needs camera access to scan the pairing QR displayed by your host's CLI.
scan_qr.key_mismatch_description: Host pubkey mismatch — this host may have been reconnected. Proceed only if you trust this QR.
scan_qr.trusted_host_description: Add this device to {{host}} (trusted host). Continue?
scan_qr.adding_device_description: Adding device to host {{host}}. The host is not yet in your device list.
scan_qr.instructions: Run {{command}} on your host, then point your camera at the QR code.
ownership_disclosure: Only pair hosts you own or are authorized to access.
